class.name: Discord
class.brief_description: Discord Social SDK integration for OAuth authentication and backend JWT exchange.
class.description: The Discord singleton dynamically loads the Discord Partner SDK library at runtime. If the library is not found beside the executable, all methods fail gracefully without crashing. Call [method initialize] with your Discord application client ID to start the OAuth flow, pump [method run_callbacks] (or rely on the engine frame hook), then use [method get_access_token] and [method authenticate_with_server] to exchange the token for a JWT from your backend.

method.name: authenticate_with_server
method.description: POSTs the OAuth access token to the auth server and returns the parsed response. Requires [constant AUTH_READY] and a non-empty access token.

method.name: clear_debug_log
method.description: Clears the in-memory debug log buffer.

method.name: clear_rich_presence
method.description: Clears the player's Discord rich presence. Requires [constant AUTH_READY].

method.name: get_access_token
method.description: Returns the OAuth access token obtained during [method initialize], or an empty string when not connected.

method.name: get_auth_state
method.description: Returns the current OAuth/auth lifecycle state.

method.name: get_connection_state
method.description: Returns the current Discord SDK connection state.

method.name: get_debug_log
method.description: Returns recent lifecycle and SDK log lines (always populated for auth/connect/presence steps; verbose SDK detail when debug logging is enabled).

method.name: get_default_communication_scopes
method.description: Returns the default OAuth scopes for communication features ([code]openid[/code] and [code]sdk.social_layer[/code]).

method.name: get_default_presence_scopes
method.description: Returns the default OAuth scopes for rich presence ([code]openid[/code] and [code]sdk.social_layer_presence[/code]).

method.name: get_game_activity
method.description: Returns the current user's game-associated activity from the SDK readback ([code]type[/code], [code]details[/code], [code]state[/code]), or an empty dictionary when unavailable.

method.name: get_granted_scopes
method.description: Returns the OAuth scopes granted by Discord after token exchange.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the most recent error message from Discord initialization or auth.

method.name: get_relationships_count
method.description: Returns the cached Discord relationships count after [constant AUTH_READY], or [code]-1[/code] when unavailable.

method.name: get_requested_scopes
method.description: Returns the OAuth scopes requested during the current auth flow.

method.name: get_user_id
method.description: Returns the connected Discord user snowflake ID after [constant AUTH_READY], or [code]0[/code] when unavailable.

method.name: get_username
method.description: Returns the connected Discord display or username after [constant AUTH_READY], or an empty string when unavailable.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns SDK version metadata and runtime library availability.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the Discord Social SDK and starts the OAuth authorization flow for the given application client ID.

method.name: is_authorization_pending
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while waiting for the user to complete OAuth ([constant AUTH_PENDING]).

method.name: is_authorized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after token exchange succeeds ([constant AUTH_AUTHORIZED] or [constant AUTH_READY]).

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the Discord Partner SDK runtime library is present beside the executable.

method.name: is_client_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the SDK client session is active (including during OAuth).

method.name: is_debug_logging_enabled
method.description: Returns whether debug logging is enabled.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method initialize].

method.name: is_ready_for_presence
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the client has reached [constant STATE_READY] and rich presence can be updated.

method.name: run_callbacks
method.description: Pumps Discord SDK callbacks. Also invoked automatically each frame when initialized.

method.name: set_debug_logging
method.description: Enables verbose SDK file logging ([code]discord.log[/code] in user data) in addition to always-on lifecycle logs.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the Discord SDK session and releases resources.

method.name: update_rich_presence
method.description: Updates Discord rich presence. Dictionary keys: [code]type[/code], [code]details[/code], [code]state[/code], [code]large_image[/code], [code]large_text[/code], [code]small_image[/code], [code]small_text[/code], [code]start_timestamp[/code], [code]end_timestamp[/code]. Requires [constant AUTH_READY]; if called earlier, the activity is cached and applied when [signal ready] fires. Returns [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED] when not ready.

signal.name: authorization_failed
signal.description: Emitted when OAuth authorization fails or the user dismisses the auth UI.

signal.name: authorization_started
signal.description: Emitted when the OAuth authorization flow begins (auth popup shown).

signal.name: authorized
signal.description: Emitted after the access token is stored and [method initialize]'s connect step begins.

signal.name: connection_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the SDK connection state changes. [param state] uses [enum ConnectionState].

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Emitted once when the client reaches [constant STATE_READY] and rich presence can be updated.

signal.name: relationships_updated
signal.description: Emitted after relationships are fetched on ready.

constants.constant: OAuth popup shown; waiting for user authorization.
Access token stored; connecting to Discord.
Client ready; social APIs including rich presence are available.
